milestone.title: M1.1 — 编辑器体验与 Web 构建优化验证
milestone.description: Bounded M1 stabilization authorized on 2026-10-11: isolated Rust egui component prototype and profile-only Web build A/B; actual native/Web builds, tests and functional/measurement evidence; adopt/reject/inconclusive decisions before production integration. No M2, new rigs, paid services or unbounded CI.

issues.body:
## What to build

IAB viewport/DPR emulation misaligns rendered egui controls and pointer coordinates, even when configured before reload. Ordinary unoverridden viewport input works. Reproduce and isolate the Winit/egui/canvas sizing boundary before changing normal HiDPI behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Retain a minimal real WebGPU reproduction with observed CSS, physical-buffer and scale dimensions.
- [ ] Pointer clicks and slider drag target the visible controls after supported resize/DPR changes.
- [ ] Regression-check normal native HiDPI and ordinary browser sizing.
- [ ] If the cause is outside Nvwa, document the exact upstream boundary and supported workaround.

## Blocked by

Original IAB DPR-emulation capability is unavailable: the current supported viewport API accepts only `width` and `height`. An exact original emulation trace or a supported physical display-scale transition is needed for the remaining diagnosis. Independent tasks can proceed.

## Evidence and scope

[M0 verification matrix](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/d74493d/docs/TEST-MATRIX.md); [actual GUI observations](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/d74493d/docs/evidence/GUI-SESSION.md)

Known M0 gap; independent of thin M1.

## 2026-10-11 supported-browser control

PARTIAL — Actual Chrome zoom100%→110%→125%→100% passes, with observed DPR2→2.2→2.5→2 and CSS size changing together. Actual Work click/settled-caret checks, typing, jaw edit/one Undo and complete saved Work restoration pass. Derek's physical125% Chinese candidates/Space, shortcuts/tab return and continuous drag/Undo checks pass separately.

The original IAB emulated-DPR trigger is unavailable in the current width/height-only API. Original failure/cause, fixed-CSS DPR isolation and physical display migration are NOT-RUN. No speculative sizing fix is selected; this issue stays OPEN. Earlier native acceptance is artifact-specific and was not repeated this turn.

[Raw evidence and reproduction](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/860d1c40e9a99dc37ff08e7a61caa93b86587219/docs/evidence/input-scale/ACCEPTANCE.md), [independent review](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/860d1c40e9a99dc37ff08e7a61caa93b86587219/docs/evidence/input-scale/REVIEW.md), publication [PR #31](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/pull/31). Checker-only stale-pair false passes were repaired;15 tests pass and pre-fix reds remain reproducible. One untrusted compositionend's origin is UNKNOWN, tracked separately in #32; it is not a demonstrated product defect.

Next decisive work needs supported original DPR-emulation capability/trace or an actual display-scale transition. Ordinary browser zoom is a passing control and cannot establish that original emulator defect is fixed or outside Nvwa.

## 2026-10-12 bounded capability recheck

The current Codex In-app Browser viewport documentation was refreshed once. Its `set(options: ViewportSize)` accepts only `height` and `width`; `reset()` clears that size override. No DPR-emulation entry is advertised. The original triggering condition remains unavailable, so no speculative product sizing change and no repeat of already-passing ordinary zoom controls was made. This issue stays OPEN with `needs-info` and all original acceptance criteria retained.

PR #33 is merged. Its fixed-CSS DPR control and native2x/window enlargement checks remain artifact-specific accepted controls; fixed-CSS continuous drag and physical display migration remain NOT-RUN. The paired input-method provenance investigation #32 is closed with UNKNOWN retained, not as a product fix. [Merged bounded evidence](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/6b5cf8068fe5f859f82a1934bfedc8b224d49e20/docs/evidence/bounded-scale-ime/ACCEPTANCE.md).

Exit for this attempt: BLOCKED by missing original capability. Next decisive input is a supported original DPR-emulation control/trace, or an actual display-scale transition. Continue independent #4 startup measurement and #5 screenshot-export diagnosis; do not interpret this blocker as completion or deletion of the original requirement.

## Published bounded checkpoint (2026-10-12)

[PR #34](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/pull/34) preserves the actual width/height-only capability documentation and [blocker](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/5af5f73e5a3a5efe8a07d03b4e51d776b8fc6c26/docs/evidence/bounded-startup-capture/issue3-blocker.md). The original triggering condition remains unavailable; no additional ordinary control rerun or product sizing patch was selected. Independent #4/#5 checks proceeded. Original acceptance criteria remain unchanged and this issue remains OPEN/needs-info.

milestone.title: M1.1 — 编辑器体验与 Web 构建优化验证
milestone.description: Bounded M1 stabilization authorized on 2026-10-11: isolated Rust egui component prototype and profile-only Web build A/B; actual native/Web builds, tests and functional/measurement evidence; adopt/reject/inconclusive decisions before production integration. No M2, new rigs, paid services or unbounded CI.

issues.body:
## What to build

M0 measured release main-loop cadence and native child RSS, not exact presented frames or GPU memory. A first native probe completed its real screenshot after 8.52 seconds; the cause is unprofiled. Web measurements used a warm browser/cache.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Instrument and report exact measurement boundaries rather than calling asset readiness first frame.
- [ ] Measure cold Web startup with documented cache/network conditions.
- [ ] Profile native first-launch stalls before attributing them to shader compilation.
- [ ] Collect GPU timings and browser/RSS memory where supported; retain NOT-RUN for unavailable metrics.
- [ ] Use one real character at 1280×720 release with competing heavy jobs stopped.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Evidence and scope

[actual measurements](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/d74493d/docs/PERFORMANCE.md)

Known M0 gap; independent of thin M1.

## 2026-10-12 bounded HTTP-cache startup result

PARTIAL — Two actual fresh-prefix, no-store IAB startups rendered the real character at1280×720/DPR1. Five critical bodies transmitted20,564,428bytes per run; an explicit optional `.glb.meta`404 adds28bytes. Exact frozen bodies, browser resource sizes and server records reconcile. Boot-hidden517.5/634.4ms and GLB responseEnd936.6/1100.8ms use separate navigation clocks; neither is first presentation.

Startup2's actual raw Rust event records AssetReady0.4248s and screenshot callback15.4457s on `bevy_TimeReal_since_first_update`; the callback includes requested15s warmup. Startup1's console capture is empty. These are separate from HTML navigation and actual download/file evidence.

VERIFIED — 11 CPU boundary tests, actual optional-metadata red/green, exact archived observations and independent agent review with corrected factual claims. Same31 accepted product inputs and retained artifacts; no product/dependency/lockfile change or new Rust build/native run.

NOT-RUN — exact first presentation, fully cold browser/GPU/OS/shader state, GPU/browser memory/timestamps and native startup attribution. Fresh URLs/no-store prove the HTTP-cache boundary only. This issue remains OPEN with all original criteria retained. Next work can independently evaluate supported native profiling or presentation instrumentation; no attribution to shader compilation is established.

[Acceptance and raw packet](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/5af5f73e5a3a5efe8a07d03b4e51d776b8fc6c26/docs/evidence/bounded-startup-capture/ACCEPTANCE.md), [experiment/reproduction](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/5af5f73e5a3a5efe8a07d03b4e51d776b8fc6c26/experiments/24-http-cold-startup/README.md), [independent agent review](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/5af5f73e5a3a5efe8a07d03b4e51d776b8fc6c26/docs/evidence/bounded-startup-capture/REVIEW.md); publication [PR #34](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/pull/34).
